strings.en: The Cipher Helmet Lock is a remarkable product designed to provide a convenient and secure solution for helmet storage. This kit contains all the non-3D printed hardware components necessary to assemble a Cipher Helmet Lock. It can be fixed onto a bicycle handle and used to lock a helmet by setting a password and inserting the helmet strap. To complete the project, you need to download the model files on MakerWorld and 3D print the parts.

context.title: Cipher Helmet Lock Kit
context.near: Overview

strings.en: Password-Protected:

context.title: Cipher Helmet Lock Kit
context.near: The lock features a password-based locking system. You can choose your desired numbers as ciphers and set them in the P6 and P7 parts. The operation of setting

strings.en: The lock features a password-based locking system. You can choose your desired numbers as ciphers and set them in the P6 and P7 parts. The operation of setting and using the password is intuitive.

context.title: Cipher Helmet Lock Kit
context.near: Password-Protected:

strings.en: Anti-Cracking Features:

context.title: Cipher Helmet Lock Kit
context.near: The lock has an anti-cracking mode that adds an extra layer of security. When the wrong combination is entered and the lock release button P11 is pushed, the P3

strings.en: The lock has an anti-cracking mode that adds an extra layer of security. When the wrong combination is entered and the lock release button P11 is pushed, the P3 part will move, preventing unauthorized access. Even if the correct numbers are turned on the cipher gears (P6 and P7), the lock will not open until the anti-cracking mode is deactivated.
